result.response:
An investigation of the failing tests revealed that comma separation (group-or) in CSS queries was handled in [`QueryParser.parse()`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/jsoup_21_group_a_blind/src/main/java/org/jsoup/select/QueryParser.java#L58-L65) using `tq.chompTo(",")`. This raw match did not account for combinators, sub-queries, or commas embedded inside balanced brackets/parentheses (such as `:matches([0-9,]+)`), causing syntax errors during parsing.

### Fix
1. Updated [`QueryParser.java`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/jsoup_21_group_a_blind/src/main/java/org/jsoup/select/QueryParser.java#L81-L106) to parse `,` alongside other combinators in `combinator(char combinator)`, appending clauses to [`CombiningEvaluator.Or`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/jsoup_21_group_a_blind/src/main/java/org/jsoup/select/CombiningEvaluator.java#L51-L68).
2. Added a no-argument constructor `Or()` to [`CombiningEvaluator.Or`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/jsoup_21_group_a_blind/src/main/java/org/jsoup/select/CombiningEvaluator.java#L62-L64) to allow building the `Or` evaluator dynamically.
3. Verified that both `org.jsoup.select.SelectorTest::handlesCommasInSelector` and `org.jsoup.select.SelectorTest::mixCombinatorGroup` pass, along with the entire test suite.
4. Saved the patch to [blind_fix.patch](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/jsoup_21_group_a_blind/blind_fix.patch).
